### 5005

**WB Setting**

Msetter: White balance. Makes white look white under different light. Cloudy and Shadow make pictures warmer, Tungsten cooler.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Auto)
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name | What it does | Not on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Auto | The camera decides. |  |
| 1 | Daylight | For sun. |  |
| 2 | Cloudy | Warmer. For clouds. |  |
| 3 | Shadow | Warmer still. For shade. |  |
| 4 | Tungsten | Cooler. For light bulbs. |  |
| 5 | HMI | For film lights. |  |
| 6 | Fluorescent (warm) | For warm tube lights. |  |
| 7 | Fluorescent (cool) | For cool tube lights. |  |
| 8 | Flash | For flash. |  |
| 9 | Gray Card | Measures from a gray card. | M11-D |
| 11 | Color Temperature | Set it in kelvin. | M11-D |

### D014

**White Balance Color Temperature**

Msetter: Color temperature. Used when white balance is Color Temperature.

- Kind: one of a list of numbers

### D13E

**Film Mode**

Msetter: Film style. Color and contrast of JPG files.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (Standard)
- Cameras: all

The menu calls this Film Style (M-EV1 manual p.69, M11-P manual p.75).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 1 | Standard |
| 2 | Vivid |
| 3 | Natural |
| 4 | Monochrome |
| 5 | Monochrome High Contrast |

### D1F4

**LTM strength**

Msetter: Extended dynamic range. Keeps more detail in bright and dark areas.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Off) on the M11, M11-P, M11-D and M-EV1; 1 (Medium) on the M11 Monochrom
- Cameras: all

The menu calls this Extended Dynamic Range (M-EV1 manual p.69).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 1 | Medium |
| 2 | High |

### D081

**Noise Reduction**

Msetter: Noise reduction. For JPG files. Lower keeps more grain and detail.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (0)
- Cameras: all

Noise reduction for JPG files (M-EV1 manual p.72).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | -1 |
| 1 | 0 |
| 2 | +1 |

### D130

**White balance grey card: red gain**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: a whole number from 0 to 2048
- Factory value: 917
- Cameras: all

Red gain from the last gray card measurement. 256 is a gain of 1.0.

### D131

**White balance grey card: green gain**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: a whole number from 0 to 2048
- Factory value: 256
- Cameras: all

Green gain from the last gray card measurement. 256 is a gain of 1.0.

### D132

**White balance grey card: blue gain**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: a whole number from 0 to 2048
- Factory value: 436
- Cameras: all

Blue gain from the last gray card measurement. 256 is a gain of 1.0.

### D3D2

**WB Adjustment Enabled**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Off)
- Cameras: all

Turns White Balance Adjustment on (M-EV1 manual p.92). D3BC and D3BD hold the adjustment.

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 1 | On |

### D3BC

**WB Adjustment: first axis**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: a whole number from -40 to 40
- Factory value: 0
- Cameras: all

One axis of White Balance Adjustment. Which color axis it moves is not yet confirmed on a camera.

### D3BD

**WB Adjustment: second axis**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: a whole number from -60 to 60
- Factory value: 0
- Cameras: all

The other axis of White Balance Adjustment. Which color axis it moves is not yet confirmed on a camera.

### 5014

**Contrast**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (Standard)
- Cameras: only the M11 Monochrom

Contrast, under Customize image properties (M11 Monochrom manual p.76). 5014 is also Contrast in the standard PTP list of camera properties.

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 2 | High |
| 4 | Medium High |
| 1 | Standard |
| 3 | Medium Low |
| 0 | Low |

### D177

**Toning**

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: -1 (Off)
- Cameras: only the M11 Monochrom

Toning (M11 Monochrom manual p.75): Off, or Sepia, Blue or Selenium, each weak or strong. It can be a Favorites item (53623). The options are matched in the order the camera lists them; not yet confirmed on a camera.

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| -1 | Off |
| 0 | Sepia (weak) |
| 6 | Sepia (strong) |
| 1 | Blue (weak) |
| 7 | Blue (strong) |
| 2 | Selenium (weak) |
| 8 | Selenium (strong) |
